newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas says business outlook strong.
newsitem.headline: Adidas says business outlook strong.

text.p: German sports retail group Adidas AG said on Tuesday that its business outlook was strong and its order backlog for 1997 had risen substantially.

In the group's annual report released at a news conference, chief executive Robert Louis-Dreyfus said: "Adidas is geared to succeed in a highly competitive environment and we are committed to sustained growth in both sales and profits."

He added: "Our business outlook is strong. The order backlog for 1997 is up substantially over last year's, at the same time demonstrating the tremendous acceptance of our brand and products by both the trade and consumers."
